# case: 65-share-host-claude-via-env
# desc: CLAUDE_CONTAINED_SHARE_HOST_CLAUDE=1 mounts host ~/.claude directly, matching --share-host-claude
# config: apple-darwin
--- exit ---
0
--- runtime-args ---
== container run ==
--rm
-it
--memory
8g
--name
aic-project-<TIME>
-e
HOST_HOME=<HOME>
-e
HOST_UID=<UID>
-e
HOST_GID=<GID>
-w
<PROJ>
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude,dst=<HOME>/.claude
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.codex,dst=<HOME>/.codex
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.copilot,dst=<HOME>/.copilot
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.gemini,dst=<HOME>/.gemini
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.vibe,dst=<HOME>/.vibe
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>,dst=<PROJ>
-e
TZ=UTC
-e
CLAUDE_CONTAINED_EXPLICIT_ENV_KEYS=TZ
-e
GIT_PROTECT_DIRS=<PROJ>
--dns
1.1.1.1
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained,dst=<HOME>/.claude-contained
claude-contained:latest
/usr/local/bin/shell-run

--- stdout ---
(empty)
--- stderr ---
(empty)
--- filesystem ---
HOME dir 755
HOME/.claude dir 755
HOME/.claude-contained dir 755
HOME/.codex dir 755
